mentions.h: BILL LUCAS "... a bold spirit in a loyal breast"
mentions.note: 3rd at the AAA Championships the year after the author's first visit
born 1914; joined August 1943; 3rd club 7 miles cross country championship (Blackstaffe Shield) 1948; 2nd in club five and three-quarter mile road race 1948

share.d: G.F. Lucas in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1998–2001: 2 mentions in 2 issues and 2 race results.
